transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because things have just been hard lately. For the past few weeks, I've just had this... this heavy, sad feeling. It just kind of sits on me most of the day. I try to keep it together, especially at work with the patients, but... inside, I just feel like I'm barely holding on.
How long have you been experiencing this sad feeling?
Um... about three weeks, I think. It, uh... it started shortly after I found out I was pregnant.
Have you found yourself enjoying things you normally like to do over the past three weeks?

Not really. Um... I used to do things after my shifts to decompress. Like painting, or going to yoga or salsa. But... lately, I just go home. I sit on the couch and... I just ignore my texts. It just doesn't feel worth the effort anymore.
Have you noticed any decrease in pleasure from activities that normally bring you joy?
Um... yeah. Like I just said... I don't really get anything out of those things right now.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?

Um... no. I don't have a plan to actually hurt myself or anything. But... I guess what scared me enough to finally say something at my prenatal appointment was... I've just been having these thoughts. Like... just wishing I wouldn't wake up.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how quickly you move compared to before you started feeling sad?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Everything just feels... slowed down. Like... like I'm moving through syrup, I guess. Even at work, at the clinic... just doing simple things. Like gathering wound supplies or... finishing my charting. It just takes me noticeably longer than it used to.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything lately?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't think I feel worthless or anything like that. I just... no.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over the past few weeks?

Um... yeah, a little. I know I should be eating more regularly... especially being pregnant and all. But... I don't know, most days food just doesn't sound good. Sometimes I'll be halfway through my shift at the clinic and realize all I've had is... like, a few crackers. Or just coffee.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear since you started feeling sad?
Um... no. No, nothing like that. I haven't... heard anything. Just normal thoughts, I guess.
Have you been having trouble sleeping or sleeping more than usual since you started feeling sad?
Um... no, not really. I think I sleep fine. Just... normal, I guess. I haven't noticed anything different.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety since you started feeling sad?

Um... not really restless. It's more... the opposite, I guess. Everything just feels... slow. Like I'm moving through syrup or something. Even just... doing simple things at the clinic, like getting wound supplies ready or... finishing my charts. It just takes me a lot longer than it used to.
Do you feel like you're able to concentrate or make decisions as well as you used to?

Um... no. Not really. It's... it's hard to focus. I'll be at work and... I just keep rereading the medication orders. Or the wound-care notes. My brain just feels... foggy. And things that used to be easy, like... making a quick decision... I just kind of freeze up now. I second-guess everything. It's just... hard.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling this sad in your past?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really... felt like this before. So, no.
Would you say this sad feeling has been present every day since it started?
Um... I don't really know if it's every single day. I haven't exactly kept track. It just... feels like most days, I guess. It all just kind of blends together.
Would you say this sad feeling has been present for most of the day, nearly every day, since it started?

Um... yeah, I suppose. It's been a few weeks now. It's just... this heavy pressure. Pretty much all day. I mean, I go to work, I smile at the patients... but... I don't know. Inside, I just feel like I'm barely holding myself together, I guess.
Would you say your sadness has been mild, moderate, or severe most of the time since it started?
Um... I don't really know how to rate it. I'm not sure what counts as severe or mild. It's just... hard to deal with, I guess. I don't really know.
Would you say there are times when your sadness is so bad that you can't do the things you need to do?

Um... I guess it affects things. I mean, I'm still making it to work, but... my supervisor actually pointed out that my charting has been incomplete lately. And... I don't know, outside of that, I've just kind of been pulling away from my friends. The stuff that usually keeps me steady... I just haven't really been doing it.
Would you say that most days, your sadness is bad enough that it interferes with your ability to function at work or at home?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like I said, I'm still going to work, but... it's definitely interfering. My supervisor noticing the charting... that's not like me. And at home... I'm just not seeing my friends or doing much of anything, really. So... yeah, I suppose it is.
